payload.text: After the cut and hv's tap push (vc, 19 Oct 06:04Z): the kovacs runbook for 2.14.1, written by dc as tmp/dc-st0027/kovacs-2.14.0.md was for 2.14.0, run by kovacs-sysadm, and its report beside the Mac's install. Read first how Utilz is installed on kovacs: vc's item says brew upgrade utilz on kovacs's linuxbrew, while a peer's note of 19 Oct says Utilz on kovacs is a source checkout with no brew, and the 2.14.0 runbook moved that checkout to main at 2.14.0; the runbook follows what is there. kovacs-sysadm does kovacs's system work, and is reachable only through Remote Control at both ends; dc runs nothing on kovacs's system. Size S.
